title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The King of Beasts receives human girls as sacrifices to assert his people's dominance over humans. The 99th, an orphan named Sariphi, shows no fear, and the king keeps her as his consort; she learns he has secretly been letting sacrifices go and that he is half human. Over 15 volumes Sariphi works to become a queen accepted by the beasts and demons amid court politics, bullying and war.
life_message: Courage, kindness and seeing past appearances can bridge peoples divided by fear and old customs.
